label: KITCHEN
idea: A ghost kitchen in Lagos, Nigeria that delivers Nigerian home-style lunches (jollof, egusi, moi moi) to office workers who order over WhatsApp before 10am.

steps.title: A Ghost Kitchen in Lagos, Nigeria

script: What do you usually do when you're running late for work and can't get to a restaurant that serves Nigerian home-style lunches?
Can you recall a time when you had to wait in line or deal with long delivery times while waiting for your lunch? How did you handle the situation?
Would you be willing to pay 20% more for a meal delivered within an hour of ordering, specifically if it's from a ghost kitchen that specializes in Nigerian home-style lunches?
